pairfor_salt.meaning: salt value computed by Launchpad's pairFor function

create2_salt.meaning: salt value used by GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory's create2 deployment

pairfor_pair_address.meaning: pair address calculated by Launchpad's pairFor function

create2_pair_address.meaning: address of the pair deployed by GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory's create2

assumptions: The pair address is fully determined by the salt used in create2, so a salt mismatch implies an address mismatch.
The pairFor calculation and create2 deployment refer to the same pair creation context.

unresolved.description: The exact salt formulas for pairFor and create2 are not provided, so the numeric relationship between pairfor_salt and create2_salt cannot be derived.
No explicit trigger or transaction sequence is provided for when the salt mismatch is exercised.

limitations: Only the direct impact i_endrewards_incorrect_address is formalized; other impacts (i_assert_valid_recipient_fails, i_endrewards_never_executes, i_launchtoken_scenarios_locked) are deferred to future claims.
The precondition p_transfer_total_fee_share_zero is not selected because it is not part of the core salt-mismatch relation.
The condition is narrowed to the salt mismatch scenario; the report does not establish a broader applicability scope.
